messages:
maria.k: Escalation from Acme Payments — hitting intermittent parse failures when using json_mode:strict on /v1/generate. They get 422 parse_error and occasionally well-formed JSON but with wrong types (id as number, line_items.discount = null vs omitted) and enum casing flip ("PAID" -> "paid"). Customer says billing spiked when fallback to text mode.

support_bot: Incoming escalation recorded: case_id=ACME-4321, webhook=webhook-9

devon: Can you paste a minimal repro curl and the exact schema you're sending? Also need request_id from their failing call.

maria.k: Repro curl below (sanitized). Schema is attached.

```bash
curl https://api.redwood.inference/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "rwd-2-large",
    "json_mode": "strict",
    "schema": {"type":"object","properties":{"invoice_id":{"type":"string"},"amount":{"type":"number"},"paid":{"type":"boolean"},"status":{"type":"string","enum":["PAID","PENDING","FAILED"]},"line_items":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"object","properties":{"description":{"type":"string"},"discount":{"type":["number","null"]}}}}},
    "prompt": "Extract invoice information from the email body..."
  }'
```

maria.k: Example of failing model output (returned with 422):

```json
{"invoice_id": 123456, "amount": "99.50", "paid": null, "status": "paid", "line_items": [{"description":"Service fee","discount":null}]}
```

oliver: That output explains billing — when json_mode fails we fall back to plain text streaming which blew up token usage. Any 5xxs in the logs during the window?

maria.k: No auth errors, but there are increased 5xxs and higher latency spikes correlated with the failures. Customer saw token usage jump ~3x for the failing session.

sre_jake: Quick mitigation: ask customer to set "json_mode": "lenient" or enable type coercion on their side. We'll also add a temporary server-side rule to prefer string coercion for invoice_id to avoid hard failures. Eng-ml should investigate model response stability for numeric-looking ids.

devon: I'll collect full request/response pairs and the exact request_id (ACME provided request_id 22F-abc). Will open an eng-ml ticket with sample and attach logs. If reproducible we'll add a targeted fallback that coerces numeric ids to strings before validation.

maria.k: Thanks — customer asked for ETA. If eng-ml can't triage within 24h we'll offer a short-term workaround and credit for excess billing.

oliver: :thumbsup:
